{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
# (Even though we don't use revenue, we do it for completeness)
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
sales = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_by_segment = sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().round(4)

# Identify the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_conversion_segment = conversion_by_segment.idxmax()

# Print results
print(f"Conversion rate by customer_segment:\n{conversion_by_segment}")
print(f"Highest conversion rate segment: {highest_conversion_segment}")"}
